input.justification: Option 1A is the only feasible plan without Keller, Alpine Drone or Vuilleumier, who are all inflexible. It bumps two jobs by one day each for CHF 100 total, against a rush premium of CHF 685, leaving a net uplift of CHF 585. Brunner Velos said a few days' delay is fine if it saves money, and Studio Meier is prepaid and flexible up to 5 days, so both are low-risk asks.
